verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Resolved item status, deploy/version tracking, and general real-time notifications and webhooks. Nothing shows a distinct alert when a resolved item reappears in a newer release, separate from new-item alerts. These are adjacent building blocks, not the regression-alert capability itself.

support.subject: As an SRE, I get alerted when an error that was fixed comes back in a newer release, distinct from ordinary new-issue noise
